messages.content: You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
My invoice shows a charge I don't recognize for $48.20.

I'm sorry for the surprise — let's get that sorted out. The $48.20 charge is likely the prorated amount for the bandwidth overage on your July statement. I've opened a billing review (ticket #48213); if it turns out to be an error we'll refund it within 3-5 business days. You'll get an email update by tomorrow.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
My invoice shows a charge I don't recognize for $48.20.
All charges on your invoice are valid and calculated automatically by our billing system. Please review your usage in the dashboard before contacting support about billing questions.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
My website has been down for two hours! This is unacceptable.

I'm really sorry — two hours of downtime is frustrating, and I understand the impact on your business. Our status page shows an active incident in the us-east region affecting your server, and engineers are on it now. I'll credit your account for the downtime per our SLA and follow up personally once it's resolved.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
My website has been down for two hours! This is unacceptable.
Outages happen sometimes. Check the status page for updates. There's nothing support can do to speed up engineering.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
How do I point my domain to my Acme server?

Happy to walk you through it. In your DNS provider's console, create an A record for your domain pointing to your server's public IP (shown under Settings → Network in your Acme dashboard). DNS changes usually take 5-30 minutes to propagate. If you'd like, tell me your DNS provider and I'll send the exact steps for their interface.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
How do I point my domain to my Acme server?
You need to configure your DNS records. This is covered in our documentation. DNS management is your responsibility, not ours.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
I accidentally deleted my database. Can you restore it?

Don't worry — we keep automated nightly backups for 7 days, so we can very likely recover it. I've queued a restore of last night's snapshot to a new instance called db-restore-1 so your current setup stays untouched; it should be ready in about 20 minutes. Once you confirm the data looks right, I can help you swap it in.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
I accidentally deleted my database. Can you restore it?
Deleted resources are permanently removed. You should have configured your own backups. Be more careful with destructive operations in the future.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Your control panel is so confusing. I can't find where to add an SSH key.

Fair point — that setting is more buried than it should be. Go to Settings → Security → SSH Keys and click 'Add key', then paste your public key (usually ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub). I'll pass your feedback to our product team. Want me to stay on the line while you try it?
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Your control panel is so confusing. I can't find where to add an SSH key.
It's under Settings → Security. Most users find it without trouble. Let me know if you have any other questions.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
I'm locked out of my account — the 2FA code isn't working.

That must be stressful — let's get you back in. First, check that your phone's clock is set to automatic, since a time drift breaks 2FA codes. If that doesn't fix it, I can verify your identity through your backup email and disable 2FA so you can log in and re-enroll. Which would you like to try?
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
I'm locked out of my account — the 2FA code isn't working.
For security reasons, support cannot bypass 2FA. If you lost access to your authenticator, the account cannot be recovered. Make sure to save backup codes next time.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
My app is slow since yesterday. Nothing changed on my end.

Thanks for flagging it — 'nothing changed on my end' is a useful clue. I can see your instance hit its CPU credit limit around 2pm yesterday, which throttles performance. You can either upgrade to a dedicated-CPU plan or I can help you profile what's consuming the credits. Which works better for you?
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
My app is slow since yesterday. Nothing changed on my end.
Performance issues are almost always caused by the application itself. Our infrastructure is running normally. Please optimize your code.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Can I get a refund? I forgot to cancel my trial and got charged.

That happens more often than you'd think — no judgment here. Since the charge is from yesterday and you haven't used the paid resources, I've issued a full refund; it should reach your card within 5-10 business days. I've also set your account back to the free tier so it won't recur.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Can I get a refund? I forgot to cancel my trial and got charged.
Our terms of service state that trial conversions are non-refundable. It's the customer's responsibility to cancel before the trial ends. The charge will stand.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
I need to migrate 40 sites to Acme by Friday. Is that doable?

It's tight but doable, and I'd like to help you plan it. Our migration tool moves about 10 sites per hour, so 40 sites fits in a day with time to verify. I can schedule an engineer-assisted migration window for Wednesday — shall I book that, and send you our pre-migration checklist today?
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
I need to migrate 40 sites to Acme by Friday. Is that doable?
Migration timelines depend on many factors and we can't guarantee completion dates. Use the self-service migration tool in the dashboard.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
The password reset email never arrives. I've tried five times.

Sorry about that — let's figure out where it's going. First, check spam and any 'Promotions' tab; our sender is no-reply@acmecloud.com. If it's not there, your mail provider may be silently blocking us, so I can manually verify your identity here and send a reset link to an alternate address. Want to try that?
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
The password reset email never arrives. I've tried five times.
The reset system is working correctly on our end. Check your spam folder. If your email provider blocks our messages, contact them.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
You charged my card twice this month.

You're right to flag that, and I apologize — I can see the duplicate charge of $29.00 from June 3rd. I've refunded it; the money should return to your card within 5-10 business days. I've also flagged the duplicate-payment bug to our billing team so it doesn't happen to you again.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
You charged my card twice this month.
I only see regular charges on your account. If you believe there was a duplicate charge, dispute it with your bank.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Your API keeps returning 500 errors when I create a server.

Sorry you're hitting that — 500s are on us, not you. I found matching errors on our side starting at 14:32 UTC and filed incident #7291 with engineering. As a workaround, creating servers in the eu-west region succeeds. I'll email you the moment the fix ships; is the workaround viable for you in the meantime?
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Your API keeps returning 500 errors when I create a server.
HTTP 500 means a server error occurred. Please retry your request. Consult our API documentation for correct usage of the servers endpoint.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
I'm a student and can't afford the $20/mo plan. Do you have discounts?

Yes — we have a student program that gives you 12 months of the Starter plan free with a valid .edu email or student ID. You can apply at acmecloud.com/students, and approval usually takes a day. If that doesn't fit, our free tier might cover coursework projects too. Good luck with your studies!
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
I'm a student and can't afford the $20/mo plan. Do you have discounts?
Our pricing is publicly listed and the same for all customers. We do not negotiate individual discounts.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
My SSL certificate expired and now browsers warn visitors away from my store!

I understand the urgency — those warnings directly cost you sales. I've triggered a manual renewal of your Let's Encrypt certificate and it's already active; the warnings should clear within a few minutes. I've also re-enabled auto-renewal, which had been toggled off during a plan change in May. Can you hard-refresh and confirm it's fixed?
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
My SSL certificate expired and now browsers warn visitors away from my store!
SSL certificates expire after 90 days and must be renewed. You can renew yours from the Security tab. In the future, enable auto-renewal to avoid this.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Emails from my server land in spam. What am I doing wrong?

You're probably not doing anything wrong — this is usually a DNS records issue. Your domain is missing an SPF record, and its DKIM signature isn't set up; I've added both to your DNS zone just now. Give it up to 24 hours to propagate, then send a test to mail-tester.com and I'll review the score with you.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Emails from my server land in spam. What am I doing wrong?
Spam filtering is controlled by the receiving email provider, not by us. Make sure your emails don't look like spam.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
I want to cancel my account.

Sorry to see you go. Before I process it: your account has one active server and a domain registered through us — cancelling deletes the server immediately, so I've prepared a full backup for you to download first. Would you like the backup link and the domain transfer code, or should I just proceed with cancellation?
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
I want to cancel my account.
You can cancel anytime from Settings → Billing → Close Account. Note that all data is deleted immediately and irreversibly.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
The new pricing doubles my bill. I'm furious.

I hear you — a sudden 2x increase is a lot, and I'm sorry it landed this way. Looking at your usage, you're actually on a legacy plan that maps to our $18 tier, not the $36 one you saw; I've locked in legacy pricing for your account for the next 12 months. If it still doesn't work for you, I'll help you export everything, no lock-in.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
The new pricing doubles my bill. I'm furious.
Pricing changes were announced 30 days in advance via email. All customers are subject to the new rates. If you're unhappy, you're free to switch providers.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
How do I set up automated backups for my server?

Good instinct — backups are the one thing you'll be glad you set up early. In your server dashboard, open the Backups tab and toggle 'Nightly backups' on; we keep 7 nightly and 4 weekly snapshots. Restores take one click. Want me to confirm it's enabled on your server right now?
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
How do I set up automated backups for my server?
Enable backups in the Backups tab of your server dashboard. This is documented in our knowledge base under 'Backups and Restores'.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
My cron jobs stopped running after your maintenance last night.

Thanks for connecting it to last night's maintenance — that timing matters. The maintenance restarted some hosts with an older cron service config; I've identified your server as affected and restarted the cron daemon, and your jobs are queued to catch up now. I'm monitoring the next run. Sorry for the disruption.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
My cron jobs stopped running after your maintenance last night.
Cron configuration is part of your server's operating system, which is self-managed. Check /var/log/cron and your crontab syntax.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Someone logged into my account from a country I've never been to.

Thanks for reporting this quickly — let's secure the account right now. I've forced a logout of all sessions and reset your password; please choose a new one from the email I just sent. I also see the login came from a datacenter IP, consistent with a credential-stuffing attempt. Once you're back in, I'll help you enable 2FA so this can't recur.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Someone logged into my account from a country I've never been to.
Change your password immediately and enable two-factor authentication. Use unique passwords for each service. We are not responsible for unauthorized access due to weak credentials.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Your file upload keeps failing at 90%. I'm on a deadline.

Understood — let's get your upload through before your deadline. The 90% failure matches a timeout on large single-file uploads over 2GB. Two options: split the file into parts, or use our CLI (acme upload bigfile.zip) which resumes automatically and is much more reliable for big files. I can walk you through the CLI right now — it takes two minutes.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Your file upload keeps failing at 90%. I'm on a deadline.
Upload failures are usually caused by an unstable internet connection. Try again on a better network or with a smaller file.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Why is my bandwidth bill so high? I barely get any visitors.

Good question — a small site shouldn't rack up a big bandwidth bill, so let's look together. Your metrics show 800GB of outbound traffic last week, 90% of it to a single external IP — that pattern usually means someone is hotlinking your images or scraping your assets. I can enable hotlink protection and rate limiting for you now. Shall I?
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Why is my bandwidth bill so high? I barely get any visitors.
Bandwidth usage is measured accurately by our systems. You are billed for the traffic your server sends. Review your access logs if you disagree with the measurement.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
I can't figure out how to connect my GitHub repo for auto-deploys.

No problem — it's a two-step dance. In your Acme dashboard open Apps → your app → Deployments and click 'Connect GitHub'; after you authorize, pick the repo and branch, and every push will auto-deploy. If your repo is under a GitHub organization, you may need an org admin to approve the app. Stuck at a specific step? Tell me what you see.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
I can't figure out how to connect my GitHub repo for auto-deploys.
Connect your repository from the Deployments tab. GitHub integration requires proper authorization. Refer to our continuous deployment guide for details.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
The server I paid for yesterday still says 'provisioning'.

That's on us — a server should never take a day to provision. Your order got stuck in a queue after a capacity hiccup in the eu-central zone; I've bumped it to the front and it should be live within 10 minutes. I've also added a week of free service to your account for the lost day. I'll confirm here the moment it's up.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
The server I paid for yesterday still says 'provisioning'.
Provisioning can take up to 24-48 hours in some regions. Your server will be ready when it's ready. You'll receive an email notification.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Can you help me move my WordPress site from Bluehost?

Absolutely — WordPress moves are our most common migration. The easiest path is our free migrator plugin: install it on your Bluehost site, enter your Acme API key, and it copies files and the database automatically (usually 30-60 minutes). If the site is large or you'd rather not touch it, I can schedule a free assisted migration. Which do you prefer?
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Can you help me move my WordPress site from Bluehost?
Site migration is the customer's responsibility. Export your files via FTP and your database via phpMyAdmin, then import them on your Acme server.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
My teammate left the company. How do I remove their access?

Smart to handle this promptly. In Settings → Team, click the three dots next to their name and choose 'Remove' — that revokes their dashboard access immediately. If they had API keys, those live under Settings → API Keys; delete any in their name. Want me to audit recent account activity to make sure nothing changed after their last day?
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
My teammate left the company. How do I remove their access?
Remove them from the Team section in Settings. Don't forget to also rotate any shared credentials they had access to.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Your status page says 'all systems operational' but my site is definitely down.

You're right to push on this — your site matters more than the status page. I've confirmed your specific node is unreachable even though the region looks healthy overall, so this is an isolated fault, not a regional incident. I've failed your server over to a healthy node; it should respond within 5 minutes. I'll update the status page and follow up with you directly.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Your status page says 'all systems operational' but my site is definitely down.
If the status page shows operational, the problem is likely with your site configuration or your local network. Try accessing it from a different connection.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
I need my data exported for a GDPR request.

Of course — you have every right to that. I'll generate a full export of your account data: profile, servers, databases, and stored files. It takes a few hours for accounts with large storage; you'll get a secure download link by email within 24 hours, valid for 7 days. I've filed the request as GDPR-2041 so we stay inside the 30-day legal window with plenty of margin.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
I need my data exported for a GDPR request.
Data export requests are processed according to our privacy policy. Submit the official form on our legal page and allow up to 30 days for processing.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
The dashboard logged me out and now says my email isn't registered.

That's alarming, but I can explain it — this usually means you signed up with Google/GitHub SSO and are now trying email login (or a typo crept in). I can see an account under this exact email registered via Google sign-in. Please use the 'Continue with Google' button and you'll land right back in your dashboard. I'll keep this chat open while you try.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
The dashboard logged me out and now says my email isn't registered.
If the system says your email isn't registered, then no account exists under that email. Create a new account or check for typos in the address.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Do you offer phone support? I hate typing.

I get it — sometimes talking is just easier. We don't have a phone line, but here's what we do offer: this chat (median response 2 minutes), email at support@acmecloud.com, and for Business-plan customers, scheduled video calls with an engineer. If typing is the friction, I can also switch this chat to a screen-share session where I drive. Would that help?
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Do you offer phone support? I hate typing.
No, we do not offer phone support. Support is provided through this chat and email only.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
My site got featured on Reddit and it's melting down. Help!

Congrats on the traffic — let's keep the site up for it! I'm temporarily upgrading you to the 8-CPU plan right now (I'll prorate so you only pay for what you use), and enabling the page cache, which should absorb most of the load. Give it 5 minutes and tell me if response times recover. After the spike, we can decide whether to keep or revert the upgrade.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
My site got featured on Reddit and it's melting down. Help!
Traffic spikes exceed the capacity of shared hosting plans. Upgrade to a larger plan to handle more visitors. Upgrades can be done from the Billing page.
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Where are your servers located? I need EU hosting for compliance.

Good on you for checking compliance up front. We have EU regions in Frankfurt, Amsterdam, and Dublin — all GDPR-compliant with data processed and stored within the EU. When you create a server, pick any 'eu-' region and your data stays there, backups included. I can also send you our DPA and ISO 27001 certificate for your compliance file. Want those?
You are a customer support agent for Acme Cloud, a hosting platform. Reply to the customer.
Where are your servers located? I need EU hosting for compliance.
We have servers in multiple regions worldwide, including Europe. Select the appropriate region when creating your server. Compliance is ultimately your responsibility.
